correctness.rationale: For generic central planes, crossing edges are section vertices. The centered base dot products have ordered magnitudes b,a,a+b. Exact edge enumeration yields the 4,5,4,3 threshold pattern. Haar coordinates give independent uniform |vertical normal| and azimuth; an explicit arcsin primitive integrates the three probabilities. A scalar strictly decreasing comparison function proves the unique global pentagon maximizer. The standalone exact-algebraic checker verified 40263 finite sign/quadrature/extremizer assertions, which corroborate but do not replace the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete Haar section-type distribution for a continuously variable solid, not a single arbitrary count. The exact trichotomy and strict unique optimal aspect ratio for pentagonal central sections are mathematically motivated by stereological section statistics. The optimizer 0.613688... differs substantially from the uniform prism height one, and the result is applicable to analytic calibration of central-section simulations.
